item.description:
Release v5.7.3

Changes since v5.7.2

  • feat(BookletMakerPlugin): add booklet maker plugin and register in LumiFactory
  • feat(DatabaseManagerPlugin): add connection persistence and sidebar mode toggle
  • feat(ImageToPDFPlugin): add image-to-PDF conversion plugin and register in LumiFactory
  • feat(SkillPlugin): hide status bar item unless current view container supports project
  • fix(ConversationListPlugin): always show attention dot regardless of selection state
  • fix(DatabaseManagerPlugin): update QueryResultView
  • fix(DatabaseManagerPlugin): update SQLiteTableView
  • fix(ImageToPDFPlugin): capture self.id in toolbar title closure to keep title scoped to plugin instance
  • fix(TerminalPlugin): fix terminal black screen by deferring shell startup and isolating view models
  • refactor(ConversationListPlugin): inject conversationManager as required dependency instead of optional state
  • refactor(ConversationListPlugin): reorganize Views into subdirectories and extract RailView
  • refactor(DatabaseManagerPlugin): reorganize views into subdirectories and extract sub-views
  • refactor(ImageToPDFPlugin): conditionally show toolbar title only when container is active
  • refactor(ImageToPDFPlugin): remove inline header and inject title via toolbar center
